game_title: Name Tag Match – Festival Grounds Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing apples before they reach siege rats.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing apples before they reach siege rats. Each round, a new apples challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 260 points of apples by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 260 within 42 seconds.
